column1: # The Rust API's access windows (spacelab::access::sgp4_windows) on its reference scans, to the bit (Ф31.C).
# Written by crates/spacelab/tests/bridge_access_reference.rs; the C ABI and the Python bridge must reproduce it. A double is the 16 hex digits of its bits.
# Angles are radians, as every bridge takes them; times are seconds past the start label on the naive UTC coordinate. Rows, tab-separated:
#   scan    <case> <TLE line 1> <TLE line 2> <EOP path from the repository root | none> <start year month day hour minute second> <span s> <mask rad> <tol s>
